name: CSV Line Parser with Quoted Fields
prompt: csv.js exports parseCsvLine(line), which splits on commas and breaks on quoted fields. Make it follow RFC 4180 for a single line: fields may be wrapped in double quotes; inside quotes commas are literal and a doubled quote ("") means one quote; quotes are removed from the result; an empty line gives [''] and trailing commas give empty fields. Throw an Error on an unterminated quote. Keep the name and export. Run it, then commit.
